Scenario fixture: frame-title-not-empty (RGAA 2.2.1)

Each target has a stable id of the form ftn_case_NN. An empty title cannot be relevant. Whether a non-empty title is relevant is left to a person.

A. Empty title (FAIL)

01 — FAIL: iframe with title=""
02 — FAIL: whitespace-only title, even with an aria-label

B. Non-empty title (PASS)

03 — PASS: iframe with a title

C. Out of scope

04 — NOT APPLICABLE: no title attribute (2.1.1's matter)
05 — NOT APPLICABLE: empty title on an aria-hidden="true" iframe
